decisions.reason: The Hero V effects of message 15 are already fully represented by its same-message MODIFY, including the black-and-white development sequence and structural construction rules.
The É accent already has a same-message MODIFY capturing the black-and-white geometry sequence; the Second V change entails no additional candidate-state change.
Message 15 already modifies and defers this treatment, recording that geometry precedes metallic application and that material enhances rather than defines the design.
The complete letterforms were already deferred pending resolution of the V system, and continuing the Second V exploration does not alter their construction requirements or lifecycle.
The complete wordmark composition was already deferred until the V system is resolved; message 15 reinforces that sequence without changing its composition, kerning, or hierarchy requirements.
Resolving the Second V in black and white does not change the established wordmark-led identity, absence of a separate icon, or standalone role of the opening V.

The sequencing change for the Second V does not alter the candidate's established identity character or ornamentation constraint; broader wording overlap is descriptive rather than a necessary state change.
